title: Cover depends on firing geometry
summary: A nearby wall or barricade does not give the same protection from every direction.
body: Cover effectiveness varies with attack angle and decreases at very close range. Walls can provide corner firing positions. Inspect actual positions and current game targeting information before choosing a firing line; cover labels or entity counts alone cannot establish protection. This record does not calculate line of sight or authorize use of hidden hostile AI job targets.

sources.supports: Directional and point-blank limitations of cover
sources.authority: Community wiki; check current game UI for consequential details

applicability.mod_caveat: Gameplay mods can change these mechanics; inspect relevant in-game definitions.

review: Read linked wiki on review date; paraphrased narrow supported claims. Not exhaustive and not independent corroboration.
